name: University College London
description: University College London is a public research university in London founded in 1826, the first university institution in England to admit students regardless of religion and the first to admit women on equal terms. It is a constituent college of the University of London and teaches across medicine, engineering, law, the sciences and the arts.
whyIncluded: UCL's Singapore page reports around 600 students from Singapore and more than 4,000 Singaporean alumni, with one of the largest Singapore societies in the UK; it is also on both the Singapore Medical Council and SILE recognition lists.

livingCosts.notes: UCL publishes no itemised general cost-of-living estimate we could read (only 'around £20,000' a year for graduate study). This is UCL's itemised 2025-26 Cost of Attendance budget (maximum amounts for US federal loans), weekly figures x 39 weeks / 9 months (undergraduate year): housing = midpoint of on-campus £309 and off-campus £257/week; food £94/week; transportation £45/week; personal = personal £60 + course materials £22 + computing supplies £11 per week. Flights, visa and health surcharge excluded. www.ucl.ac.uk blocks automated access; read from the Wayback Machine copy dated 2026-05-16, so marked secondary.

programmes.name: International Management BSc
programmes.notes: International fee for 2025 entry, the latest the School of Management page shows; later years are projected. UCL's cohort fee guarantee could not be confirmed on an official page (ucl.ac.uk blocks automated access), so fees are treated as rising yearly.

programmes.name: MSc Management
programmes.notes: Same fee for Home and Overseas students; 1-year programme.

programmes.name: Law LLB
programmes.notes: International fee for 2027 entry (2027/28) from UCL's official Law LLB prospectus page (UK £10,050). No separate compulsory fees. www.ucl.ac.uk blocks automated access, so the page was read through a reader proxy (r.jina.ai) on 2026-09-30, hence sourceType secondary. UCL's cohort fee guarantee for international undergraduates could not be confirmed on an official page, so fees are treated as rising yearly. The 2026 prospectus page shows only the UK fee, so no history.

programmes.name: Law LLM
programmes.notes: Overseas full-time fee for 2026/27 entry (UK £24,100); one-year programme. UCL's official Law LLM page (ucl.ac.uk/prospective-students/graduate/taught-degrees/law-llm) lists the 2027/28 fees as 'to be confirmed' and the 2026 version of the page could not be read (www.ucl.ac.uk blocks automated access), so the 2026/27 figure comes from a secondary aggregator and should be replaced with the official 2027/28 fee once published. No separate compulsory fees.

programmes.name: Medicine MBBS BSc
programmes.notes: Overseas fee for 2026/27 entrants from UCL's official 2026 Medicine MBBS BSc prospectus page (UK £9,790). The programme lasts six academic years but UCL bills overseas students in five annual instalments of £57,300 (an averaged rate: 2 x £39,200 pre-clinical plus 3 x £69,367 clinical), subject to annual increases of no more than RPI-X, and states that fixed fees for Overseas students do not apply; durationYears 5 therefore reflects the number of fee years. The 2027 entry page shows the fee as N/A (not yet published). www.ucl.ac.uk blocks automated access, so the page was read through a reader proxy (r.jina.ai) on 2026-09-30, hence sourceType secondary. Additional costs (DBS check, equipment, placement travel) excluded.
